name: Conference USA Cross Country Championships
headline: Conference USA Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Middle Tennessee swept the team titles in Huntsville. The women won with 25 points to Liberty's 65 and Kennesaw State's 105, with MTSU's Evalyne Wambui taking the individual title in 19:25.2. The men's race went to Jacksonville State's Shadrack Kipkurgat in 23:21.6, and MTSU won the team title with 31 points to Jacksonville State's 56 and Liberty's 70.
